headline: Speeding up compensation procedures, suspension of foreclosures and employment contracts among support measures
summary: The government is seeking to contain the fallout with faster compensation, suspended foreclosures and employment contract support for the burned area.
why: Government support measures after natural disasters affect household finances and local economic recovery.
